files.rawText:
MindWave Batch mw_115: Invariant verification and canonical receipts.
Scope: Frame stabilization (mw_11), TrueWill boundary enforcement (mw_72), Tri-Lens logic (mw_102).

fabrications.content: Use bio-luminescent fiber nodes for quantum optical state diagnostics.
A deterministic mechanism for cryptographic receipt chain validation across asynchronous node handoffs.
License real-time invariant verification oracle to distributed AI agent clusters.
INV:MW115_1 — Every Source Code quote in 03_INVARIANTS must be an exact substring of the concept document.

workflowChecks.title: Create Concept Doc
workflowChecks.governingPrinciple: One concept = one doc. No duplicate numbers.

workflowChecks.title: Register in 00_INDEX.md
workflowChecks.rule: Add one row to mindwave/00_INDEX.md: | NN | [mw_NN_name](mw_NN_name.md) | description |
workflowChecks.governingPrinciple: Global table of all canonical units

workflowChecks.title: Bidirectional Related Links
workflowChecks.rule: Add Related: in the new doc. In each linked doc, add this mw_XX to its Related line (bidirectional).
workflowChecks.governingPrinciple: No orphaned nodes, bidirectional link graph

workflowChecks.title: Section in 03_INVARIANTS.md
workflowChecks.rule: In mindwave/03_INVARIANTS.md add ## From mw_NN -- Title header

workflowChecks.title: Update INVARIANTS_INDEX_template.md
workflowChecks.rule: Add concept block and table (Invariant | Code | Link to 03)
workflowChecks.governingPrinciple: Quick navigation index for test suites

workflowChecks.title: Concept Doc Invariant Link
workflowChecks.rule: In new concept doc, link to INVARIANTS_INDEX_template and §5

workflowChecks.title: Derive Invariants From Concept Doc Only
workflowChecks.rule: Read concept doc; derive invariants only from this doc (no generic templates)

workflowChecks.title: Extraction Checklist & Tri-Lens
workflowChecks.rule: Apply checklist: verbatim single-line quote (no ellipsis); Tri-Lens (English + Code + Math)

workflowChecks.title: Write Invariants in 03_INVARIANTS.md
workflowChecks.rule: Under ## From mw_NN, write ### Invariant N: (INV:MWNN_...) with anchors {#inv-mwNN-...}

workflowChecks.title: Update Invariant Index Table
workflowChecks.rule: Add table rows: Invariant | Code | Link to 03 (#L<line>)

workflowChecks.title: Canonical Invariant Quotes in Doc
workflowChecks.rule: Add section: "Canonical invariant quotes (Source Code, for traceability)" with exact phrases
workflowChecks.governingPrinciple: Receipt chain (mw_92): doc -> canonical quotes -> 03 -> validator

workflowChecks.title: Run Coherence Checks & E-Check
workflowChecks.rule: Run python mindwave/MW_SCRIPTS/run_mindwave_checks.py; E-check must pass (exit code 0)
workflowChecks.governingPrinciple: Canonical gate: no invariant canonical until it survives E (mw_99)

workflowChecks.title: Update Project Minutes
workflowChecks.rule: Update project_minutes.md: Last Updated, Batch summary, invariant coverage, next batch range

workflowChecks.title: Enhancement Clarity Decision
workflowChecks.rule: Enhancement adds clarity. If it adds confusion, make no changes.
workflowChecks.governingPrinciple: Do no harm to stable concepts

workflowChecks.title: Non-Contradictory Doc Update
workflowChecks.rule: Edit mw_XX_*.md with clarity-preserving additions; never remove existing invariants

workflowChecks.title: Re-run Coherence Checker
workflowChecks.rule: Run run_mindwave_checks.py from repo root after enhancement; E check must pass

invariants.sourceCodeQuote: The quantum lattice propagates excitation vectors across nearest-neighbor nodes within one Planck interval.
invariants.solobicLogic: Latency minimization requires immediate topological neighbor delegation.

invariants.sourceCodeQuote: No excitation vector may be extinguished without committing an irreversible receipt to the audit ledger.
invariants.solobicLogic: Receipt chain preservation ensures full historical reproducibility.

invariants.sourceCodeQuote: No invariant is canonical until it survives E—every Source Code quote must be traceable to the concept doc.
invariants.solobicLogic: Only verified verbatim substrings pass the canonical validator gate.
